_comment: forbidden_paths only lists what's specific to this role; the project's shared build files (config/project.json: shared_build_files) and **/.claude/** are always forbidden regardless of this contract - enforced by role_contract_validator.py at runtime. 15-sep: Write added, scoped by may_write to the round directory.
